message: Versioned manifest with run/configuration IDs, UTC collection interval, file hashes, explicit inventory completeness and collection failures; devices with roles, sites, Red security-level IDs and interface/zone bindings; physical/link topology separately from logical interfaces; ordered filter rules with defaults and direction; routes, XFRM policies/states or MACsec settings with paired endpoints and layer; positive same-level traffic and negative cross-level/bypass probes; negotiation and authentication records with algorithms, certificate identity/chain validity/revocation, lifetimes; management records isolated from data-path records. No assertions of physical independence, eligibility, personnel/approval/legal compliance or all-time behavior without external records.
